Class ModelloTask

java.lang.Object
org.apache.tools.ant.ProjectComponent
org.apache.tools.ant.Task
org.codehaus.modello.ant.ModelloTask
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class ModelloTask extends org.apache.tools.ant.Task
Ant task running Modello generators, the counterpart of the modello-maven-plugin goals.

Required: version, outputDirectory, at least one nested <model> and one <goal>. Each model is generated once per goal; see README.md for all attributes and nested elements.
